slice.real_problem: M20B reached canonical sequence 5298 and 2993 while streaming deltas represented more than 98 percent of stored events. The 5.87 MB evaluator journal also duplicated complete Store snapshots, so production RuntimeEvent and SQLite amplification must be measured independently before any event-shape change.
acceptance: measure canonical event count, delta payload bytes, SQLite plus WAL footprint, append wall time, credential-free reopen wall time, Run API event retrieval plus canonical JSON serialization, TUI canonical projection and headless stream projection
use the actual StateStore, AgentApplication Run API, CanonicalRunProjection and headless serializer rather than a copied reducer, Store or client protocol
repeat each real-scale profile after one warmup and report every sample, median, minimum and maximum
make no production change unless one pre-registered absolute material-loss threshold and the stability gate both pass

any candidate must preserve concatenated content and reasoning bytes, partial-response fail-closed behavior, no-blind-retry accounting, latest-revision evidence, exact SQLite reopen, SIGKILL recovery and CLI/TUI/API semantic projection
slice.single_owner: RuntimeEvent streaming-delta emission remains owned by crates/runtime and wire-frame parsing remains owned by crates/deepseek; StateStore and clients remain consumers. A candidate may change only one owning boundary after the baseline identifies it.
slice.old_path_replaced: one canonical StateStore transaction and one StoredRuntimeEvent per non-empty DeepSeek content or reasoning SSE delta
slice.evidence: credential-free deterministic benchmark plus existing M21 partial-response, StateStore reopen, process SIGKILL and surface-parity conformance
slice.cutover_deletion: if admitted, remove the per-frame emission branch it replaces and keep no compatibility reader, dual event truth or alternate client reducer; if not admitted, delete any experimental production candidate and record reject
non_goals: journal compression or rewriting frozen M20B evidence
second Store, Runtime, protocol, sender or projection
GitHub, remote CI, push or release
DeepSeek credential, official API, external network or model call
Auto, FIM, Provider, multi-Writer or prompt changes

material_loss_gate.stability: for the triggering wall-time metric, measured maximum must be no more than 1.50 times the measured median

required_quality: byte-identical concatenated reasoning and content for complete responses
partial reasoning/content remains actionable and replay-unsafe
no completion commit without supported finish plus DONE and usage contract
no additional retry or side effect
exact event prefix, attempt identity, accounting, transcript, latest-revision evidence and terminal after SQLite reopen and process SIGKILL
CLI/TUI/API project the same ordered bytes and terminal facts
required_efficiency: canonical streaming-delta event count and SQLite plus WAL bytes each improve by at least 50 percent on both profiles
at least one baseline material wall-time metric improves by at least 20 percent
no measured wall-time metric regresses by more than 10 percent
no added wait beyond bytes already available in the same transport chunk
candidate_gate.complexity: one existing owner, no new schema truth, no mode/config/user surface, and net code must be justified by the measured absolute loss

decision.if_candidate_fails_quality: reject_quality_or_recovery_regression; delete candidate and retain baseline
decision.if_candidate_fails_efficiency: reject_no_stable_net_efficiency; delete candidate and retain baseline
decision.if_all_gates_pass: keep_minimal_streaming_delta_convergence and physically delete the replaced per-frame path
